annotations.title: x402 pre-pay check with on-chain payer proof

description: [Kyreos, 0.002 USDC per call via x402 on Base] Before paying an x402 URL: reads its 402 envelope (payTo, amount, network) and joins the host to a chain-stamped index of 3,763 sellers (distinct payers, USD settled, last settlement). Returns PAY/CAUTION/AVOID with reasons, same shape as SI Sentinel. Proof is per host, refreshed hourly. Input: ?url=https://seller.example/priced-route. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/x402-precheck?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.002 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (0.002 USDC on Base)
